const string EDA_GROUP = "NATIVE QA"
bool edaEnabled = input.bool(false, "Entry decision audit (Pine Logs)", group=EDA_GROUP, display=display.none)
bool rcQa = input.bool(false, "Export RC2 QA journal", group="NATIVE QA", display=display.none)
int rcQaStart = input.time(timestamp("01 Oct 2026 00:00 +0000"), "QA start UTC", group="NATIVE QA", display=display.none)
int rcQaEnd = input.time(timestamp("11 Nov 2026 06:00 +0000"), "QA end UTC", group="NATIVE QA", display=display.none)
bool edaBar = edaEnabled and rcQa and processBar and tvEntryFrame and syminfo.tickerid == "OANDA:XAUUSD" and time_close >= rcQaStart and time_close <= rcQaEnd
f_edaKey(string tag) =>
    tag + "|1|" + syminfo.tickerid + "|" + timeframe.period + "|" + f_int(time_close)
f_edaState(TvCandidateState s) =>
    f_int(s.phase) + "|" + f_int(s.bornTime) + "|" + f_int(s.born) + "|" + f_num(s.anchor) + "|" + f_num(s.level)

string edaBefore = edaBar ? f_edaState(array.get(tvCandidateStates, idx)) : ""
        int edaLast = edaBar ? array.get(tvCandidateLast, idx) : na

if edaBar
            float edge = d == 1 ? close - low : high - close
            string cooldown = attempted ? str.tostring(na(edaLast) or bar_index - edaLast > minCooldown) : "NA"
            log.info(f_edaKey("EDA_SIDE") + "|" + f_int(d) + "|" + edaBefore + "|" + f_int(edaLast) +
                 "|" + f_edaState(array.get(tvCandidateStates, idx)) + "|" + str.tostring(attempted) + "|" + why +
                 "|" + f_num((close - open) * d) + "|" + f_num(atr) + "|" + f_num(edge / barRange) + "|" + cooldown +
                 "|" + f_num(d == 1 ? tvRange20Low : tvRange20High))

f_edaPaperId(Paper s) =>
    s.phase == 0 or na(s.p) ? "" : str.replace_all(s.p.id, "|", "~")
Paper edaPaperBefore = edaBar ? array.get(books, 3) : na
int edaBeforePhase = edaBar ? edaPaperBefore.phase : na
string edaBeforePlan = edaBar ? f_edaPaperId(edaPaperBefore) : ""

if edaBar
    Paper rawPaper = array.get(books, 3)
    string context = f_edaKey("EDA_BAR") + "|" + f_int(rcFirstOpen) + "|" + f_int(bar_index) +
         "|" + f_num(open) + "|" + f_num(high) + "|" + f_num(low) + "|" + f_num(close) +
         "|" + str.tostring(warmup) + "|" + str.tostring(readyHTF) + "|" + htf +
         "|" + f_int(uiH1ClosedAt) + "|" + f_int(rcCurrent.context.h1) +
         "|" + f_int(uiH4ClosedAt) + "|" + f_int(rcCurrent.context.h4) + "|" + str.tostring(tvTimeGap)
    string gates = f_num(atrMean) + "|" + str.tostring(validATR) + "|" + f_num(barRange) + "|" + f_num(maxEntryBarATR) +
         "|" + str.tostring(datePass) + "|" + str.tostring(newsPaused) + "|" + str.tostring(sessionPass)
    string decision = f_int(edaBeforePhase) + "|" + edaBeforePlan + "|" + f_int(rawPaper.phase) + "|" + f_edaPaperId(rawPaper) +
         "|" + (na(rcSelected) ? "" : str.replace_all(rcSelected.id, "|", "~")) +
         "|" + (na(rcSelected) ? "NA" : str.tostring(f_tvQtyOnGrid(1.0))) +
         "|" + str.tostring(rc2FilterActive) + "|" + str.tostring(rc2Blocked) +
         "|" + dvClosedPermission.state + "|" + str.replace_all(dvClosedPermission.reason, "|", "~") + "|" + f_num(syminfo.mintick)
    log.info(context + "|" + gates + "|" + decision + "|" + f_num(minATRratio) + "|" + f_num(maxATRratio) +
         "|" + f_num(minStopATR) + "|" + f_num(maxStopATR) + "|" + f_num(maxCostRisk) + "|" + f_num(maxOpenDeviationATR) +
         "|" + f_int(minCooldown) + "|" + f_num(RC2_RANGE_ATR_LIMIT) + "|" + f_int(time) +
         "|" + f_num(close[1]) + "|" + f_int(rcEarlySide) + "|" + f_int(structureUpNow ? 1 : structureDownNow ? -1 : 0))
